title: Functorial total-limit realization of integral compact support
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$, a uniformizer $\varpi$, and $A_n=R/(\varpi^n)$, $n\ge1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a separated finite-type morphism between separated finite-type $k$-schemes with the small pro-etale operation datum [def-fix-six-functor-datum]. Put $B_W=\varprojlim_n(A_n)_W$ for $W=X,Y$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], and $\mathcal A_W=\operatorname{Mod}(B_W)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Fix one compactification $c=(h,p)$ of $f$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Use the specified coherent exact $R$-linear functor $\mathcal T_f^c:D(\mathcal A_X)\to D(\operatorname{Tow}(\mathcal A_Y))$ of [lem-weil-compact-support-reduction-tower-functor] and the total derived inverse-limit functor $L_Y$ of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit].

On the full integral constructible subcategory $\mathcal C_X=D^b_c(X,R)$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], the composite $F=L_Y\mathcal T_f^c$ is a functorial realization of the integral $Rf_!^c$ defined by [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support]: $F(K)$ with its total-limit Roos triangle is a derived limit [def-weil-derived-limit] of precisely the system $(\operatorname{Res}_n Rf_{!,n}^c(K\otimes^L_{B_X}(A_n)_X))_n$ with the defining quotient-induced transitions. One may choose these objects as the defining derived limits, with $Rf_!^c(u)=L_Y(\mathcal T_f^c(u))$ for every morphism $u$ of $\mathcal C_X$. This choice realizes the definition as an exact $R$-linear functor [def-weil-triangulated-category, def-weil-linear-functor] into the ambient $D(\mathcal A_Y)$. Its shift comparison is $s_F=L_Y(s_{\mathcal T})$ followed by $s_{L_Y}$; for every distinguished triangle with third arrow $w$, its image third arrow is exactly $s_F F(w)$. The identification is of derived objects and their chosen coherent maps; it does not assert that arbitrary choices of derived-limit objects or maps are canonically identical, nor that finite evaluations determine a derived-tower morphism.

source.note: Agent-written realization of the unspecified derived-limit choices. Stacks Tags 0940 (section-derived-limits) and 0941 (lemma-derived-limit-is-ok), sites-cohomology.tex; Tag 08TC (definition-derived-limit), derived.tex. The source constructs total Rlim and its Roos triangle, not uniqueness of arbitrary limit maps.

proof.text: Write $T=\mathcal T_f^c$ and $Q_n(K)=\operatorname{Res}_n Rf_{!,n}^c(K\otimes^L_{B_X}(A_n)_X)$. Apply the reduction-tower theorem with base field $k$ and the fixed compactification $c$: $\ell$ is invertible since $\ell\ne p$. Its natural evaluation isomorphisms identify $\operatorname{ev}_nT(K)$ with $Q_n(K)$ on objects and maps. Its stated transition formula is exactly the quotient-induced formula in the integral compact-support definition, including the coefficient-restriction comparison and the equality of the two iterated restrictions. The theorem also identifies every composite transition with reduction $A_m\twoheadrightarrow A_n$. Thus the evaluated system, with its specified identifications, is the defining system, not merely a family of isomorphic objects.

proof.text: Use the proved complex-level Roos construction of the ringed strict-tower theorem with the specified right-derived inverse-limit functor. Transport its evaluated tower through the localization comparison with the canonical evaluation functors, using the proved evaluation and transition normalization formulas in the coefficient constant-tower Roos module. Its first arrow agrees with the specified coefficientConstantTowerProjection: on K-injective complexes both satisfy the same resolution normalization, so uniqueness identifies them. The connecting arrow is natural by the short-exact-complex construction. Transport the resulting natural triangle by the product of the specified compact-support evaluation isomorphisms. The transition identities intertwine 1-s, giving exactly the defining compact-support derived-limit triangle.

For $u:K\to K\prime$ set $Rf_!^c(u)=L_Y(T(u))$. Identities and composition are preserved because $T$ and $L_Y$ are functors. Naturality of the tower identifications and of the Roos triangle gives the chosen maps between the triangles of Step 2. This specifies the maps using the whole derived-tower morphism $T(u)$; it does not try to recover that morphism from its finite evaluations.

proof.text: Inverse limit is linear, as follows by composing with every limit projection. Apply the existing proved linear_rightDerivedFunctor instance in WeilConjectures.CategoryTheory.DerivedCategory.RightDerivedFunctor.Linear. Identify the chosen normalized sheaf scalar actions with the coefficient scalar action: finite quotient residue sections are unique, and their compatible limits identify the constant sections. The uniqueness of integralCoefficientLinear then identifies the standard derived scalar action with sfIntegralCoefficientLinear. Thus the constructible inclusion, the specified tower, and total limit compose to the required linear functor with the fixed target scalar structure. The proved normalizedDerivedLinear helper in CompactSupportRepresentativeIndependence supplies the scalar-structure comparison; no representative-comparison theorem is assumed here.

proof.text: The integral constructible subcategory is triangulated and its full inclusion is exact, by the integral-constructible triangulation theorem. Restrict the ambient composite to it. For a distinguished triangle $K\to M\to N\xrightarrow{w}K[1]$, exactness of $T$ gives third arrow $s_{T,K}T(w):T(N)\to T(K)[1]$. Exactness of $L_Y$ then gives third arrow $s_{L_Y,T(K)}L_Y(s_{T,K}T(w))=s_{L_Y,T(K)}L_Y(s_{T,K})F(w)$. Therefore define $s_{F,K}=s_{L_Y,T(K)}\circ L_Y(s_{T,K})$. This is a natural isomorphism, and the displayed calculation proves distinguishedness with exactly the stated third arrow. Restriction preserves the linearity from Step 4 since the subcategory is full. These choices establish the asserted realization in the ambient target category.
